rationale: The stock gapped up nearly 6% but failed to sustain the breakout, rejecting sharply from the session high and consolidating in the lower third of the daily range. Price is currently trading below both the 5-minute VWAP and the 9-period EMA, with volume drying up during the consolidation, indicating short-term seller control. Given the broader market weakness and the failed gap structure, a short entry targeting a retest of the session low offers a favorable risk-to-reward profile with invalidation placed just above the 5-minute VWAP.
